official_sources.title: PROJ current release
official_sources.finding: Current stable documentation identifies PROJ 9.8.1 as the 2026-04-10 release; runtime version is a coordinate-operation provenance dependency.

official_sources.title: PROJ coordinate-operation computation
official_sources.finding: PROJ computes candidate coordinate operations from CRS metadata, area of use and transformation metadata rather than a single fixed formula.

official_sources.title: projinfo operation query controls
official_sources.finding: projinfo exposes area-of-interest, contains/intersects spatial tests, grid availability checks, ballpark filtering and accuracy filtering.

official_sources.title: ONLY_BEST option
official_sources.finding: ONLY_BEST=YES errors when the best known transformation cannot be used because required grids are unavailable.

official_sources.title: ALLOW_BALLPARK option
official_sources.finding: ALLOW_BALLPARK=NO disallows ballpark transformations from the candidate set.

official_sources.title: ACCURACY operation filter
official_sources.finding: ACCURACY sets the minimum desired candidate-operation accuracy in metres and must be recorded if used.

official_sources.title: Grid availability policy
official_sources.finding: Grid availability can be used for sorting, discarding missing-grid operations, ignored, or treated as known available; policy changes candidate ranking.

official_sources.title: PROJ network capabilities
official_sources.finding: Network-enabled PROJ may fetch required grid chunks from the CDN and caches them locally, so network/cache state can change operation usability.

official_sources.title: PROJ resource search paths
official_sources.finding: PROJ searches explicit paths, API search paths, user writable directories, PROJ_DATA and installation paths for transformation resources.

official_sources.title: PROJ_DATA environment variable
official_sources.finding: PROJ_DATA controls resource-file locations and multiple directories may be searched; path order is runtime provenance.

official_sources.title: proj-data package
official_sources.finding: proj-data contains freely distributable transformation grids used by PROJ; installed resource content must be version-pinned.

official_sources.title: projsync version filtering
official_sources.finding: projsync filters resource files against PROJ_DATA.VERSION metadata by default, tying grid compatibility to the installed proj.db metadata.

official_sources.title: PROJ grid CDN provenance
official_sources.finding: Remote transformation grids are registered in proj.db and mirrored through the PROJ-data/CDN ecosystem; exact grid identity matters.

official_sources.title: Pipeline operator
official_sources.finding: A PROJ transformation can be a sequential pipeline of multiple operations; terminal replay should persist the exact pipeline definition and order.

official_sources.title: Horizontal grid shift priority
official_sources.finding: Multiple horizontal grids are prioritized in list order and @ marks optional grids, so grid order and optionality alter runtime behavior.

official_sources.title: Vertical grid shift priority
official_sources.finding: Vertical grid lists are prioritized and optional-grid markers are allowed; multiplier defaults and grid choice affect output heights.

official_sources.title: Vertical grid multiplier
official_sources.finding: vgridshift uses Z_target=Z_source+multiplier*gridvalue and historically defaults multiplier to -1, so sign/multiplier must be explicit.

official_sources.title: General grid shift interpolation
official_sources.finding: General gridshift may apply horizontal and vertical offsets and supports interpolation selection, including grid-specified interpolation metadata.

official_sources.title: Time-dependent transformations
official_sources.finding: Dynamic transformations may depend on coordinate epoch; PROJ supports CRS@epoch/CoordinateMetadata and time-dependent Helmert or deformation operations.

official_sources.title: projinfo source/target epoch
official_sources.finding: projinfo exposes --s_epoch and --t_epoch for dynamic CRS coordinate epochs, requiring epoch provenance when applicable.

official_sources.title: CoordinateMetadata API
official_sources.finding: PROJ CoordinateMetadata attaches an epoch to a CRS and both source and target metadata can participate in epoch-changing operation selection.

official_sources.title: Dynamic CRS frame epoch
official_sources.finding: Dynamic reference frames carry a frame reference epoch and optionally a deformation model name; frame epoch is distinct from coordinate epoch.

official_sources.title: PROJJSON CoordinateMetadata
official_sources.finding: PROJJSON supports CoordinateMetadata and datum_epoch fields, enabling machine-readable epoch provenance.

official_sources.title: Last used operation API
official_sources.finding: proj_trans_get_last_used_operation returns the operation actually used when a transformation object has several alternatives.

official_sources.title: Operation accuracy metadata
official_sources.finding: PJ_PROJ_INFO exposes an operation accuracy field; this metadata is operation-level and is not itself measured target elevation accuracy.

official_sources.title: PROJ error handling
official_sources.finding: PROJ maintains context-local error state; nonzero errors must be captured rather than silently accepting failed transformation setup or execution.

official_sources.title: cs2cs only-best and no-ballpark
official_sources.finding: cs2cs exposes --only-best, --no-ballpark and --accuracy controls, confirming these are operational selection controls rather than documentation-only concepts.

official_sources.title: 4D cct transformation
official_sources.finding: cct is a 4D transformation utility and supports temporal coordinates, providing an independent replay path for explicit transformation pipelines.
